description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to declave the excisable articles which are exempt from the payment of Excise (Special Provisions) Duty w.e.f. 02.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which exempts certain excisable articles from payment of Excise (Special Provisions) Duty. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
